data_description.host: IP address of the SPC panel on your network.
data_description.port: TCP port this integration listens on; the panel connects to it (Communications → FlexC → ATS in the panel).
data_description.encryption_key: The 64-hex-digit AES-256 key of the FlexC ATS on the panel.
data_description.command_username: FlexC command login of the ATS (Communications → FlexC → Command Profile). Its command profile decides what Home Assistant may do: read status, control doors, areas and outputs, manage users and codes, calendars and more. A function whose command the profile does not allow is shown as not allowed in the Capabilities sensor.
data_description.command_password: Password of the command login above.
data_description.engineer_username: Optional engineer (installer) login. Only needed to enter and exit full engineer mode from Home Assistant, and for functions that need engineer mode (zone configuration). An engineer login can change the whole panel configuration; leave empty unless you need this.
data_description.engineer_password: Password of the engineer login above.

enable_pin_management.name: Enable PIN management
enable_pin_management.description: Lets Home Assistant change the PIN on this user number without the current PIN. The consent belongs to the number, not the person: it stays when the user is deleted, so a new user on the same number is managed too. Give the current PIN of the user on this number: its key is learned and stored in Home Assistant's private storage (never in logs or attributes). The PIN cannot be checked over FlexC, so a wrong PIN gives a wrong key; the key is confirmed when the user logs in at a keypad with a PIN Home Assistant set.

disable_pin_management.name: Disable PIN management
disable_pin_management.description: Forgets the stored key of this user number. Changing a PIN on it then needs the current PIN again.
